clips.title: The story
paras: The Sacred Flame is the final task in Rau Cliffrunner's investigation into the Galak centaur of Thousand Needles. Armed with blessed waters, a Horde adventurer must penetrate Splithoof Hold, extinguish the tribe's revered brazier, and claim the ancient Cloven Hoof relic.

North of Freewind Post lies Splithoof Crag, the heart of the Galak centaur domain in Thousand Needles. Deep within its cavernous den, Splithoof Hold, burns a fire that the centaur hold sacred. After preparing an etched phial filled with purified water, Rau Cliffrunner tasks his allies with penetrating the subterranean stronghold, using the water to momentarily quench the flame, and snatching the prize guarded within: a relic known as the Cloven Hoof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Using the water you brought, you will be able to temporarily douse the flame that holds the centaur relic. It will not work permanently, however, so you will have to be quick about it.
You will find Splithoof Crag, the centaurs' stronghold, to the north of here. The flame is kept in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.
Be careful, though, the Galak centaur have great numbers here, and will be rather reluctant to surrender something so dear to them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I am eager to put my hands upon the Cloven Hoof. Have you taken it yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I sense a strange energy emanating from the Hoof... I have no doubt that we will discover surprising new information about the centaur from its study.
My thanks, friend. Now I must begin to decipher the mysteries you have brought to me.
